test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The university has putting off / the semester examination / for the second time now / due to technical issues.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase** "The university has putting off"** is grammatically **incorrect **because it combines "has" with the base form of the verb "putting" without the appropriate form of "to be" (been) for the continuous tense.
 
• The correct form of the phrasal verb "put off" in this context should be "been putting off" to indicate the present perfect continuous tense.
 
• The **present perfect continuous **tense is used here** to show that the action** (the delaying of the semester examination) started in the past and continues up to the present.

Therefore, the complete correct sentence is ***The university has been putting off **the semester examination for the second time now due to technical issues.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• the semester examination: This segment is correctly structured and contains no grammatical error.
 
• due to technical issues: Correctly provides the reason for the postponement and is grammatically correct.
 
• for the second time now: Properly indicates the frequency of the event and is grammatically appropriate within the sentence.
